description: Resolve an exact citation (URN:NIR) to an Italian national act — e.g. "urn:nir:stato:decreto.legislativo:2003-06-30;196" (the Privacy Code). Returns the act's title, type, emanation date, Gazzetta Ufficiale publication date (kept separate from emanation and from in-force dates), and the opening text (preamble through the start of Article 1). Pass as_of (YYYY-MM-DD) for the version in force on that date (multivigenza), or original: true for the text as originally enacted — default is the current consolidated text. For a specific article's text, use it_normattiva_get_article instead. Source: Istituto Poligrafico e Zecca dello Stato (IPZS), Normattiva Open Data.

as_of.description: YYYY-MM-DD — the version in force on this date (multivigenza). Omit for the current consolidated text.

original.description: true — return the text as originally enacted, ignoring later amendments.

urn.description: URN:NIR citation, e.g. "urn:nir:stato:decreto.legislativo:2003-06-30;196", or urn:nir:stato:<tipo.atto>:<yyyy-mm-dd>;<numero> built from an it_normattiva_search result.

name: it_normattiva_get_act
title: It Normattiva Get Act
